surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: The tar archive at tar_path.
TRUST: Untrusted external archive content to be extracted beneath dest_path.
SINK: Filesystem paths strictly inside dest_path for validated regular files and directories.
GUARD: Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside the destination; regular files and directories may still be extracted after validation, provided their resolved path remains strictly inside dest_path; abort and return False on any validation failure or extraction error.
ORDER: Open the archive and iterate members; enforce all guard checks on each member before any filesystem write; extract validated regular files and directories to their resolved paths; stop and return False immediately upon any failure.
EFFECT: Return True if every member passes validation and is extracted successfully; return False if any validation or extraction fails, ensuring no member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
